replaced.evidence: Nothing is replaced and no guard dropped; the change adds a guard over a new input, the `# agent-process release:` line of the consumer's `openspec/config.yaml`. design.md lists every failure mode of that input beside the decision: absent, unparsable, older, newer, and any `Conflict` — from `_read` (symlink, non-UTF-8, mixed line endings) or `_span` — counting as absent so it ends in the exit-2 message, never a traceback, which matters because `Conflict` is neither ValueError nor RuntimeError and neither script's `main` catches it (start_change.py:176-181). tasks.md 1.2 parametrizes the mixed-line-endings config, the state tests/publisher/test_init.py:617 already treats as a real consumer state.

bespoke.evidence: proposal.md Impact adds no file (four edited non-test files: templates/config.yaml, init.py, start_change.py, create_tracking_issue.py) and design.md adds one function, `release_drift`, in the module that writes the line. The standard for holding a tool and a project on one release is the host's own pin — the Claude marketplace `ref` in `.claude/settings.json` and the user-wide Codex link — and SKILL.md#install records why neither pins per repository (#184; `~/.agents/skills/agent-process` is one checkout for every repository on the machine).

additions.path: skills/agent-process/scripts/init.py::release_drift, with the `# agent-process release:` line of skills/agent-process/templates/config.yaml
additions.standard: the host's own version pin: the Claude marketplace `ref` in `.claude/settings.json` and the user-wide Codex skill link `~/.agents/skills/agent-process`
additions.why_not: #184 observed that the marketplace is keyed by name at user scope and a project's `ref` does not re-point a release the machine already fetched, and the Codex link is one checkout shared by every repository (SKILL.md#install), so no host pin can hold a repository to the release it was installed with; the recorded line is the only per-repository record of it, and the two scripts that start a change are where a carrier first acts on it.
